name: Pinefall Village
description: Steep snowy roofs under tall pines at the foot of Frostpeak. The furrier sells warm gear; the inn keeps a fire for climbers.

name: Ropebridge Outpost
description: A watchtower and a brazier beside the long rope bridge over the glacier. The guards share their fire with anyone who climbs this far.

name: Cloud Monastery
description: Curved roofs on a crag above the sea of clouds. The monks brew tonics against the cold and sell talismans to the brave.

name: The Last Cairn
description: A stone cairn and a torn tent below the dragon's peak. Climbers leave a stone here before the last ascent.
